comments.text:
Completed implementation of the catppuccin theme:
- Added standalone static/themes/catppuccin.css based on Antharchy/Omarchy catppuccin color palette.
- Added "catppuccin" to AVAILABLE_THEMES in markusmd.themes.
- Added [data-theme="catppuccin"] styles to static/markus.css.
- Added BDD feature scenarios in features/themes.feature and updated features/site.feature.
- Verified with behave (all 135 scenarios passing), ruff lint, and demo site build.
